name: Home for the Heart
source:
Celine is a college student whose parents had recently lost their jobs. She lost her scholarship after failing to keep up her grades due to her family problems, and on top of that, she even got kicked out of the dormitory after being unable to pay the monthly rent. With nowhere to go, she seeks the help of her best friend, Lyle, who refers her to a family friend who accepts boarders in their house. But the said house already has occupants, cousins Joshua and Philippe, who seem to find something to fight about in every little thing. Caught in the middle of a fierce rivalry, how will Celine manage to get through this stage in her life?

[From [url=https://ran.itch.io/home-for-the-heart]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
席琳是一名大学生，她的父母最近失业了。由于家庭原因，她的成绩没能保持好，失去了奖学金，甚至还因为付不起每月的房租而被赶出了宿舍。由于无处可去，她寻求最好的朋友莱尔的帮助，莱尔将她介绍给一位接受寄宿生的家庭朋友。但这所房子已经有了住户，表兄弟约书亚和菲利普，他们似乎在每件小事上都能找到值得争吵的地方。陷入激烈的竞争之中，Celine将如何度过人生的这个阶段呢？
